title: Mission informs risk management
summary: The organisational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management.
typical_evidence: Mission statement linked to security strategy

title: Stakeholder expectations
summary: Internal and external stakeholders and their cybersecurity needs and expectations are understood.

title: Legal and contractual requirements
summary: Legal, regulatory and contractual cybersecurity requirements, including privacy, are understood and managed.

title: Critical services others depend on
summary: Critical objectives, capabilities and services that stakeholders depend on are understood and communicated.

title: Dependencies of the organisation
summary: Outcomes, capabilities and services the organisation depends on are understood and communicated.

title: Risk management objectives
summary: Risk management objectives are established and agreed by organisational stakeholders.

title: Risk appetite and tolerance
summary: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated and maintained.

title: Part of enterprise risk management
summary: Cybersecurity risk management is included in enterprise risk management processes.

title: Risk response direction
summary: Strategic direction describing appropriate risk response options is established and communicated.

title: Risk communication lines
summary: Lines of communication for cybersecurity risks, including supplier and third-party risks, are established across the organisation.

title: Standard risk method
summary: A standardised method for calculating, documenting, categorising and prioritising cybersecurity risks is established and communicated.

title: Strategic opportunities
summary: Strategic opportunities (positive risks) are characterised and included in risk discussions.

title: Leadership accountability
summary: Organisational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk and fosters a risk-aware, ethical and continually improving culture.
typical_evidence: Board or leadership security reporting; charter

title: Roles and authorities
summary: Roles, responsibilities and authorities for cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood and enforced.

title: Adequate resources
summary: Adequate resources are allocated in line with the cybersecurity risk strategy, roles and policies.

title: Security in HR practices
summary: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices.
typical_evidence: Screening; onboarding and offboarding security steps

title: Policy established
summary: Cybersecurity risk management policy is established from context, strategy and priorities, then communicated and enforced.

title: Policy reviewed and updated
summary: Policy is reviewed, updated, communicated and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology and mission.

title: Strategy outcomes reviewed
summary: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy and direction.

title: Strategy coverage reviewed
summary: The strategy is reviewed and adjusted to cover organisational requirements and risks.

title: Risk management performance evaluated
summary: Organisational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed for adjustments.

title: Supply chain risk programme
summary: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management programme, strategy, objectives, policies and processes are established and agreed.

title: Supply chain roles
summary: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers, customers and partners are established, communicated and coordinated.

title: Supply chain risk integrated
summary: Supply chain risk management is integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management, assessment and improvement.

title: Suppliers known and prioritised
summary: Suppliers are known and prioritised by criticality.

title: Supplier requirements in contracts
summary: Requirements addressing supply chain risks are established, prioritised and built into contracts and other agreements.
typical_evidence: Security clauses in vendor contracts; DPAs

title: Due diligence before engagement
summary: Planning and due diligence reduce risks before entering supplier or third-party relationships.

title: Supplier risks monitored
summary: Risks from suppliers, their products and services are understood, recorded, prioritised, assessed, responded to and monitored over the relationship.
typical_evidence: Annual vendor reviews; vendor SOC reports

title: Suppliers in incident planning
summary: Relevant suppliers are included in incident planning, response and recovery activities.
typical_evidence: IR plan with vendor contacts; contract notification clauses

title: Supply chain practices across the lifecycle
summary: Supply chain security practices are integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise programmes and their performance is monitored across the technology lifecycle.
typical_evidence: SBOM or dependency management; vendor lifecycle procedure

title: Exit provisions
summary: Supply chain plans include provisions for activities after a partnership or service agreement ends.
typical_evidence: Exit and data return clauses; offboarding checklist

title: Hardware inventory
summary: Inventories of hardware managed by the organisation are maintained.

title: Software and services inventory
summary: Inventories of software, services and systems managed by the organisation are maintained.
typical_evidence: SaaS and system inventory; cloud resource inventory

title: Network and data flows
summary: Representations of authorised network communication and internal and external data flows are maintained.

title: Supplier services inventory
summary: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained.

title: Asset prioritisation
summary: Assets are prioritised by classification, criticality, resources and impact on the mission.

title: Data inventory
summary: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained.
typical_evidence: Data inventory or records of processing

title: Lifecycle management
summary: Systems, hardware, software, services and data are managed throughout their life cycles.

title: Vulnerabilities identified
summary: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated and recorded.

title: Threat intelligence received
summary: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information-sharing forums and sources.

title: Threats identified
summary: Internal and external threats to the organisation are identified and recorded.

title: Impacts and likelihoods
summary: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded.
typical_evidence: Risk assessment with likelihood and impact

title: Inherent risk understood
summary: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and prioritise responses.

title: Risk responses planned
summary: Risk responses are chosen, prioritised, planned, tracked and communicated.

title: Changes and exceptions assessed
summary: Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded and tracked.
typical_evidence: Change records with risk assessment; exception register

title: Vulnerability disclosure handling
summary: Processes for receiving, analysing and responding to vulnerability disclosures are established.
typical_evidence: security.txt or disclosure policy; report handling records

title: Hardware and software authenticity
summary: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed before acquisition and use.
typical_evidence: Procurement security checks; signed software verification

title: Critical suppliers assessed
summary: Critical suppliers are assessed before acquisition.

title: Improvements from evaluations
summary: Improvements are identified from evaluations.

title: Improvements from tests and exercises
summary: Improvements are identified from security tests and exercises, including those with suppliers.

title: Improvements from operations
summary: Improvements are identified from running operational processes, procedures and activities.

title: Response and recovery plans maintained
summary: Incident response and other cybersecurity plans are established, communicated, maintained and improved.
typical_evidence: IR, BCP and DR plans with review dates

title: Identities and credentials managed
summary: Identities and credentials for authorised users, services and hardware are managed.
typical_evidence: IdP user export; service account inventory

title: Identity proofing
summary: Identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on interaction context.
category: PROTECT: Identity Management Authentication and Access Control

title: Authentication
summary: Users, services and hardware are authenticated.
category: PROTECT: Identity Management Authentication and Access Control

title: Identity assertions protected
summary: Identity assertions are protected, conveyed and verified.
category: PROTECT: Identity Management Authentication and Access Control

title: Least privilege and access reviews
summary: Access permissions are defined in policy, managed, enforced and reviewed, using least privilege and separation of duties.
category: PROTECT: Identity Management Authentication and Access Control

title: Physical access
summary: Physical access to assets is managed, monitored and enforced in line with risk.
typical_evidence: Office access controls; cloud provider report

title: General awareness training
summary: Personnel receive awareness and training so they can do general tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind.

title: Specialised role training
summary: Individuals in specialised roles receive awareness and training for their roles.

title: Data at rest protected
summary: Confidentiality, integrity and availability of data at rest are protected.

title: Data in transit protected
summary: Confidentiality, integrity and availability of data in transit are protected.

title: Data in use protected
summary: Confidentiality, integrity and availability of data in use are protected.

title: Backups
summary: Backups of data are created, protected, maintained and tested.

title: Configuration management
summary: Configuration management practices are established and applied.

title: Software maintained
summary: Software is maintained, replaced and removed in line with risk.

title: Hardware maintained
summary: Hardware is maintained, replaced and removed in line with risk.

title: Logs generated
summary: Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring.

title: Unauthorised software prevented
summary: Installation and execution of unauthorised software are prevented.

title: Secure software development
summary: Secure software development practices are integrated and their performance is monitored throughout the SDLC.
typical_evidence: SDLC policy; code review and scanning settings

title: Networks protected
summary: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorised logical access and usage.
typical_evidence: Firewall or security group rules; segmentation

title: Environmental threats
summary: Technology assets are protected from environmental threats.

title: Resilience mechanisms
summary: Mechanisms achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations.

title: Adequate capacity
summary: Adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained.

title: Networks monitored
summary: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events.

title: Physical environment monitored
summary: The physical environment is monitored to find potentially adverse events.

title: Personnel activity monitored
summary: Personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find potentially adverse events.

title: Service provider activity monitored
summary: External service provider activities and services are monitored to find potentially adverse events.
typical_evidence: Vendor access logs; OAuth app review

title: Hardware, software and runtime monitored
summary: Computing hardware and software, runtime environments and their data are monitored to find potentially adverse events.
typical_evidence: EDR; cloud threat detection (GuardDuty; SCC; Defender)

title: Adverse events analysed
summary: Potentially adverse events are analysed to better understand associated activities.

title: Information correlated
summary: Information is correlated from multiple sources.

title: Impact and scope estimated
summary: The estimated impact and scope of adverse events are understood.

title: Event information shared
summary: Information on adverse events is provided to authorised staff and tools.

title: Threat intelligence in analysis
summary: Cyber threat intelligence and other contextual information are integrated into the analysis.

title: Incidents declared
summary: Incidents are declared when adverse events meet the defined incident criteria.

title: Response plan executed
summary: The incident response plan is executed with relevant third parties once an incident is declared.
typical_evidence: Incident records following the IR plan

title: Reports triaged
summary: Incident reports are triaged and validated.

title: Incidents categorised
summary: Incidents are categorised and prioritised.

title: Incidents escalated
summary: Incidents are escalated or elevated as needed.

title: Recovery criteria applied
summary: The criteria for starting incident recovery are applied.

title: Root cause analysis
summary: Analysis establishes what happened during an incident and its root cause.

title: Investigation actions recorded
summary: Investigation actions are recorded and the records' integrity and provenance preserved.

title: Incident data preserved
summary: Incident data and metadata are collected with integrity and provenance preserved.

title: Magnitude estimated
summary: An incident's magnitude is estimated and validated.

title: Stakeholders notified
summary: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents.
typical_evidence: Notification records; regulator and customer notices
category: RESPOND: Incident Response Reporting and Communication

title: Information shared
summary: Information is shared with designated internal and external stakeholders.
category: RESPOND: Incident Response Reporting and Communication

title: Incidents contained
summary: Incidents are contained.

title: Incidents eradicated
summary: Incidents are eradicated.

title: Recovery plan executed
summary: The recovery part of the incident response plan is executed once started.

title: Recovery actions prioritised
summary: Recovery actions are selected, scoped, prioritised and performed.

title: Backups verified before use
summary: The integrity of backups and other restoration assets is verified before use.

title: Post-incident operating norms
summary: Critical functions and risk management are considered when setting post-incident operating norms.

title: Restored assets verified
summary: The integrity of restored assets is verified, systems and services are restored and normal status is confirmed.

title: End of recovery declared
summary: The end of recovery is declared on defined criteria and documentation is completed.

title: Recovery progress communicated
summary: Recovery activities and progress are communicated to designated internal and external stakeholders.

title: Public updates
summary: Public updates on incident recovery are shared using approved methods and messaging.
typical_evidence: Status page or public statement procedure
